title: Smart data models - Actuator schema
description: A device that is used by, or implements, an (Actuation) Procedure that changes the state of the world.

type.description: Property. NGSI entity type. It must be equal to `Actuator`

madeActuation.description: Property. Model: ''. Relation between an Actuator and the Actuation it has made.

isHostedBy.description: Property. Model: ''. Relation between a Sensor, Actuator, Sampler, or Platform, and the Platform that it is mounted on or hosted by.
